notes: Per-spec leveling reservations (sim-accuracy round 10). Below 60 a band's talent build is the guide's level-60 build cut down by the top-row-down walk (sim/leveling LadderTalentString). A spec listed here takes these ranks of its own tree first, in order, each once the build can legally hold it and never past the guide's own rank for that talent, then walks as before; so the ladder only ever adds points and its level-60 build is the guide's. A row is adopted only where the band builds it makes beat the plain walk's beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001 (10,000 iterations, the band's own heal profile, both factions), keep every talent the engine models only by a probe as zero, drop nothing the rotation casts and lose at no band. The evidence is in design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round10/healprofile.md and design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round11/healprofile.md. sim/leveling embeds a copy (make ladder-first-sync); TestEmbeddedLadderFirstMatchesCurated holds it to this file. An order-only row (owner, 2026-11-04) moves no published band: where the bands tie, real leveling play decides the order, and its reason says why in one line.

druid-feral-bear.reason: The rotation casts Lacerate (the 15-point row, rank 1 at 25, behind Savage Fury 2) and Primal Bite (the 30-point row, rank 1 at 40, behind Leader of the Pack). A level 30 druid's 21 points hold Lacerate and a level 40 druid's 31 hold Primal Bite, but the plain walk spends them on Shredding Attacks and Blood Frenzy. Taking each as soon as it fits raises threat on the tank fight beyond error at bands 20 (Savage Fury's first rank for Feral Swiftness's, about 5%), 30 (about 41%) and 40 (about 19%), both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 13, hybrids); damage taken rises about 1 to 2% without the dodge points. Bands 50 and 60 already carry both and do not change.

druid-restoration.reason: On each band's own fight, Restoration levels better with Heart of the Wild, all three ranks of Reflection and Bloom ahead of the top rows' other points, and Nature's Swiftness held as soon as it can be: beyond error at band 20 (round 11's pull profile, both factions) and band 30 (round 10), and no band loses.

hunter-beast-mastery.reason: Order only (owner, 2026-11-04; sim-accuracy round 15, hunter): Focused Fire, 2% more damage for you and the pet, opens at 15 and outvalues the last Endurance Training points (pet health and armor) on every pull from 15 to 18; the published bands hold the same points either way.

hunter-survival.reason: The rotation casts Strider Kick (the 20-point row, learned at 30). A level 30 hunter's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Predator's Edge's fifth rank. Taking Strider Kick as soon as it fits gains about 10% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane); the other bands do not change. Lacerating Strikes, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it.

mage-arcane.reason: The rotation casts Arcane Blast (the 10-point row, learned at 20). The plain walk spends level 20's eleventh point on Arcane Resilience's armor and reaches Arcane Blast only at 27. Taking Arcane Concentration's five ranks and then Arcane Blast as soon as they fit puts Blast at 20 in place of that armor point: +0.2% at band 20 and +17 to +21% at 25, at seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; the other bands do not change (sim-accuracy round 15, mage wave 2).

mage-fire.reason: The level 60 build carries Accelerant 5/5 and Burning Soul 2/3 (sim-accuracy round 23, from the raid build's +2.3% at bare 60), and the plain walk spends Accelerant's first-row ranks at 16 to 19, ahead of Ignite, which puts Pyroblast at 20 but Heating Up at 33 and Combustion at 43 (band 30 about -13%, 40 about -6%). This list keeps the old order for everything the rotation casts: Incineration 5, Accelerant 1, Ignite 4, Pyroblast at 20 (sim-accuracy round 13: about +2% at band 20 over Ignite's fifth rank), Ignite 5, then Accelerant 2 to 4 at 22 to 24 in place of Flame Throwing and Burning Soul (a faster Fireball, your filler below 30), Improved Fire Blast, Improved Scorch, Heating Up at 30, Master of Elements, Critical Mass, Fire Power and Combustion at 40; Accelerant 5 and Burning Soul 2 follow at 41 to 43. Against the old ladder at 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: +0.7 to +1.0% at 22, +1.4 to +2.7% at 24 and 25, +0.8 to +1.0% at 27, +1.4 to +1.6% at 50, +1.5 to +1.8% at 57, +2.3 to +3.8% at 60; 10, 20, 30, 35, 38, 40, 45 and 55 unchanged. Levels 41 to 43 lose 0.2 to 0.6% (Wand Specialization moves from 41 and 42 to 44 and 45: the walk spends the own tree first); no checkpoint loses.

mage-frost.reason: Frost casts Frostbolt from level 4. The plain walk's level-10 point is Frost Warding, armor on Frost Armor; Improved Frostbolt first makes the point a faster Frostbolt: +2.0 to +2.9% at band 10, at seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; the other bands do not change (sim-accuracy round 15, mage wave 2).

paladin-holy.reason: On band 30's own fight, Oath of Light ahead of Infusion of Light's second rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (sim-accuracy round 11). The plain walk also spends Holy points a healer cannot use while live ones wait: at band 20 the 11th point goes to Purifying Power (Cleanse cost and the Exorcism and Holy Wrath cooldowns, none of which the healer casts) instead of Illumination, and at band 30 the 19th goes to Divine Precision (Holy spell hit; heals cannot miss) instead of Infusion of Light's second rank. Illumination's first rank, Divine Favor (which the rotation casts), Illumination to four ranks, Oath of Light, Illumination's fifth rank and both ranks of Infusion of Light, in that order, raise band 20's effective healing about 3.5% on its own fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001, hold band 30 level, and leave bands 35 to 60 on the plain walk (sim-accuracy round 15, paladin). The order keeps every level's build a superset of the level before (the walk takes the longest legal prefix) and still takes Oath of Light at 25.

paladin-protection.reason: Holy Shield, which the rotation casts from rank 1 at 30, sits on the 21-point row; a level 30 paladin's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the 21st on Improved Righteous Fury. Taking Holy Shield as soon as it fits (and Shieldsworn as soon as it fits, the capstone the spine already gave band 40) raises band 30's threat beyond error on the tank fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 12, hybrids); damage taken rises about 2% with the Improved Righteous Fury point gone. No other band changes. Templar's Bulwark (the 10-point row, no level gate since the 70707 hotfix) is reserved ahead of them by owner ruling (first, because the walk takes the longest legal prefix of the list and Holy Shield cannot fit below 30) (sim-accuracy round 14): at band 20 it takes the second Sacred Duty point, which shortens only Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Bulwark itself. On the tank fight chance of death falls from about 77% to 66% for about 2% less threat; survival wins for a tank at this band, a stated exception to the threat metric that is not generalised to other bands or specs. Bands 25 and up already hold Bulwark and do not change.

priest-discipline.reason: On band 20's own fight, Meditation ahead of Mental Agility's first rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; on band 30's, Penance (which the rotation casts) ahead of Soul Warding does too; no other band changes.

priest-holy.reason: Prayer of Mending, which the rotation casts, is the Holy tree's deepest talent; the plain walk leaves it out at band 40. Taking it there, with Spiritual Healing's three ranks taken as soon as they can be held (ahead of Spiritual Guidance's last ranks), beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes.

priest-shadow.reason: Wand Specialization 2/2 at 10-11, then Spirit Tap 5/5, the order every Forever guide that orders them gives (Icy Veins Forever Shadow leveling https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/shadow-priest-leveling, 2026-11-02: 'Your first priority is to pick up Wand Specialization'; Kargoz's Forever 1-60 guide on Mobalytics). The wand is 37 to 41% of a leveling priest's damage on the band fight: +10.1% at band 20 and +5.7% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001. A ladder only adds points, so Shadowform moves from 40 to 42 (band 40 -36%); a priest spends thirty levels before 40 and two after it, and the guides take the same trade (sim-accuracy round 15 wave 6, an owner call the lane decided). Spirit Tap changes no number on the band fight (no kills). Shadow Focus, Improved Mind Blast, Improved Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Improved Mind Flay follow ahead of Blackout, which the band fight does not model, so band 30 holds Improved Mind Flay (+5.9% alliance, +4.8% horde over the Wand-first walk's band 30, which lacked it and lost 1.8 to 2.4%). Mind Flay is not reserved: on the band-20 fight a rank-1 Mind Flay loses to wanding (the fight runs out of mana), so it lands at 28.

rogue-assassination.reason: The rotation casts Mutilate (the 30-point row since client 1.60.1.70755, behind Venom, learned at 40). The plain walk never reaches Venom on the way down, so Venom and then Mutilate are taken as soon as each fits: Venom at 29, where it also makes every Shank raise your poisons, and Mutilate at 40. Before 70755 Mutilate sat on the 20-point row and was taken at 30 for about 8% at band 30 (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane).

rogue-subtlety.reason: The rotation casts Premeditation (the 10-point row since client 1.60.1.70755), Ghostly Strike (the 15-point row) and Hemorrhage (the 20-point row, behind Serrated Blades 3). They are reserved in tier order, Elusiveness's first rank ahead of Ghostly Strike because the engine does not model it (Vanish is never cast), so every level only adds points. On the 70753 trees the reservation gained about 2.6% at band 20 and 6.7% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Initiative (a combo point on every Garrote, cast after each Ghostly Strike) is held from 24, two points before Ghostly Strike and the third after it, in place of Camouflage and Elusiveness, which only pay the row tolls: +0.4% at level 25 and +1.0% at level 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane).

shaman-enhancement.reason: The rotation casts Stormstrike, which sits in the 15-point row. Its spell is a level 40 spell, but the talent teaches it whenever the row is open: beta logs (foreverlogs.gg reports 2712, 2717, 2753, 2805) show Enhancement shamans of level 25 to 35 casting it. The plain walk spent a level 30 shaman's 21 points on Flurry's fourth rank instead; holding Stormstrike as soon as it fits takes that point and gains about 25% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 15, shaman lane). Rage of the Farseer (the 30-point row, used on cooldown) is held next so band 40 keeps the plain walk's point in it; bands 40 to 60 already carry both and do not change.

shaman-restoration.reason: On band 20's own fight, Mindfulness's second rank ahead of Tidal Focus's last rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (round 11); Water Shield, which the rotation casts, taken as soon as it can be held (ahead of Tidal Focus's fourth rank) beats that beyond error at band 20 too, both factions (round 12); no other band changes. Mana Tide Totem (the 15-point row), which the rotation casts, is held next: at band 30 it takes Tidal Mastery's point and gains about 1.9% effective healing, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane); Nature's Swiftness and Riptide at 30 and 40 measured lower or under 1% and are not reserved.

warlock-affliction.reason: The rotation casts Siphon Life (the 20-point row, learned at 30). A level 30 warlock's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Pandemic. Taking Siphon Life as soon as it fits gains about 1.3% at band 30, beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Wrack, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it.

warlock-demonology.reason: The rotation casts Soul Link before the pull (the 20-point row, behind Demonic Sacrifice). A level 30 warlock's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Decimation's second rank, which does nothing before Soul Fire at 48. Taking Soul Link as soon as it fits gains about 2.3% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Demonic Sacrifice is not reserved: the rotation never casts it without Demonic Pact, and at 20 it could only replace Demonic Aegis, which the engine does not model; the walk reaches it on its own by 30.

warrior-arms.reason: The rotation casts Mortal Strike (the 30-point row, learned at 40, behind Sweeping Strikes). A level 40 warrior's 31 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Weaponmaster. Taking Mortal Strike as soon as it fits gains about 20% at band 40, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Improved Overpower is held first, from 15: Overpower is cast from 12, while the walk's Improved Tactical Mastery only keeps rage through a stance change, which the rotation makes only for Recklessness from 50; +3.3% at level 20, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane).

warrior-fury.reason: The rotation casts Death Wish (the 20-point row). A level 30 warrior's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Enrage. Taking Death Wish as soon as it fits gains about 3.8% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Bloodthirst, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it.
